cloud.title: Library sync
cloud.description: Sync EPUB files and reading progress across devices with sync enabled. Every 5 minutes while the app is running; Android must remain in the foreground.
cloud.permissions: Authorization lets the app create and use the private EpubReaderInfo repository to sync books and reading progress across devices. Sync only operates in this repository; signing in does not upload data.
cloud.limits: 20 MiB per book. Bookmarks and notes are not synced. Automatic sync keeps the current reading position. Disabling sync does not delete local books or the GitHub repository.

manage.delete_note: Deletes local books, reading progress and annotations. Copies in the GitHub repository will remain.
sync.scope_note: Authorization lets the app create and use the private EpubReaderInfo repository to sync books and reading progress across devices. Sync only operates in this repository; signing in does not upload data.
sync.content_limit: 20 MiB per book. Larger books remain readable locally.
sync.scope_detail:
GitHub’s repository authorization (repo) covers accessible public and private repositories and cannot be granted for just one repository.
The app restricts sync reads and writes to your private EpubReaderInfo repository. The repository is created or reused, and books and progress are uploaded, only after you enable sync.
sync.contributions_note: Off by default. When off, commits use the app identity without being attributed to your GitHub account. When on, they use your GitHub identity. Sync still works either way.
sync.contributions_detail: This applies to future sync commits from this device, starting with the next sync. Set it separately on other devices. Existing commits are not rewritten. Creating and initializing the repository may add separate contributions. Visibility also depends on GitHub’s Private contributions setting.
